stage_notes.crate_text: Crate text pool (phrase + word queries, fallbacks): prod p50 ~150 ms, worst ~450 ms
stage_notes.qdrant_fp2000: Qdrant fingerprint prefetch of 2000 with payload: ~85 ms
stage_notes.fp_full: fingerprint scan over ~50k eligible titles (in-process matrix 50k x 74, or Qdrant scroll cache): ~2-5 ms
stage_notes.qemb: query embedding on app-server CPU: e5-small ~3-8 ms (ONNX/torch), bge-base ~9-20 ms
stage_notes.qdrant_emb: Qdrant vector query on a new named vector (top 300-1000, ids + scores): ~10-20 ms
stage_notes.fp_payload: fingerprint scores for the candidates (payload or local matrix): ~5-40 ms
